intro: Read the text carefully. Annotate it: underline key words and write your ideas in the margin.

parts.text: Democracy has two Greek parts. Demos means people. Kratos means power. So democracy is power of the people.

questions.model: Democracy has two Greek parts. Demos means people. Kratos means power. So democracy is power of the people.

questions.q: Name one group who could not vote.
In the portal response box, answer: 'Was Athens really a democracy?' with one paragraph for and one against. Starter: 'On one hand ... On the other hand ...'
Compare Athenian democracy with voting in the UK today.
questions.a: Today all adult citizens 18 and over can vote in UK general elections; women can vote
